x-comment: Placeholder location. This schema is meant to be published at https://schema.wikimedia.org/repositories/mediawiki/api/fragments/pagination-v1-beta.json, which is how other schemas refer to it. Until it is published there, that URL does not resolve. The "next" structure is not final.
description: Envelope of a paginated list. The schema of the entries in "items" is defined by each endpoint.

items.description: The entries of this page of the list.

next.description: How to request the next page, or null if there are no more pages.

params.description: Query parameters to pass back, together with the original ones, to get the next page.
